acronyms.Financial: Decisions that have a United States Dollar (USD) value or financial implication
acronyms.Non financial: Decisions that do not have a United States Dollar (USD) value or financial implication
acronyms.Propose (P): Authority refers to initiating and leading development of content. This authority level also represents ownership of managing the end-to-end process from development to approval.
acronyms.Review and / or Recommend (R): Authority is a non-blocking authority that requires the authority owner to provide its review/ recommendation/feedback on the case. This authority is exercised prior to the approve authority.
acronyms.Endorse: Authority confirms its support for the proposal before final approval. Endorsement demonstrates agreement with the recommendation but does not constitute the final decision.
acronyms.Approve (A): Is the highest level of authority that concludes the process of decision taking and is followed by implementation of the decision.
acronyms.Ratify (Y): Authority formally confirms and validates a decision that has already been approved or taken. Ratification provides official governance recognition and does not reopen the underlying decision unless specifically required.
acronyms.Notify (N): Authority requires the concerned entity of this authority to receive post-approval decision briefing.
